method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: S&P 500 Ends Week Flat as Strong Jobs Growth Fuels Fed-Hike Bets
Equities.reason: Broad-market macro narrative: hot jobs data lifts Fed-hike odds, pushes yields higher and dents risk appetite — negative for overall equities and growth multiple expansion.

Equities.title: Dow Jones Industrial Average falls on a jobs number the president loves
Equities.summary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average trades just short of 53,400, roughly 325 points or 0.6% lower on Friday, after August Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) printed 162K against a 56K forecast at 12:30 GMT and pushed the probability of a September hike above 60%.
Equities.reason: Rate-sensitivity: article gives headline NFP surprise and sharp re-pricing of September hike — immediate negative for equities via higher yields and shorter-duration growth stock underperformance.

Equities.title: Traders Flock to Bullish Chinese Stock Bets for AI Alternative
Equities.reason: Market-regime / thematic: rotation/flow into Chinese AI exposures signals alternative risk-on avenues and reinforces AI as dominant market leadership theme — supportive for risk assets and sector-specific equities.

Equities.title: Foxconn says third quarter to outperform market expectations on AI strength
Equities.reason: Sector signal: major supply-chain player flags AI-driven demand upside, reinforcing positive outlook for hardware and semiconductor supply-chain equities.

Equities.title: Nvidia to buy AI platform Hugging Face for nearly $13B
Equities.reason: Big-tech / AI leadership: large strategic M&A in AI ecosystem strengthens platform concentration and positive narrative for AI leaders and related equities.

Rates.title: Fed’s Hammack says policy is not restrictive enough
Rates.summary: Cleveland Federal Reserve (Fed) President Beth Hammack said on Friday that the current monetary policy stance is not restrictive, emphasizing that inflation is too high.
Rates.reason: Direct Fed official signalling policy is insufficiently restrictive increases odds of further tightening or a hawkish stance — negative for bond prices (yields higher). High relevance given policymaker source.

Rates.title: Strong August jobs report sends yields higher
Rates.reason: Headline payroll surprise is a major macro data beat that lifts Fed-hike odds and pushes Treasury yields up — large negative for bonds and the dominant short-term rates impulse.

Rates.title: Treasuries Slide After Strong Jobs Data Lift Fed Hike Wagers
Rates.reason: Market reaction piece: strong jobs => selling in Treasuries as Fed-hike probability rises. Reinforces the hawkish/jobs-driven selloff narrative for rates.

Rates.title: World's biggest sovereign wealth fund plans to cut U.S. Treasury holdings
Rates.summary: Norway's $2.3 trillion investment fund says it can diversify into new areas with greater risk and returns.
Rates.reason: A large long-term investor trimming Treasury allocations implies weaker demand for U.S. government bonds — a structural negative for bond prices / positive for yields.

Rates.title: US equity funds record second weekly outflow on Iran tensions, high yields
Rates.reason: Notes that higher yields are already affecting asset flows (equity outflows), indicating spillovers from rising rates into markets — modestly negative signal for bond prices as yields remain a market driver.

FX.title: Sterling’s rally stalls as US jobs data reopens Fed debate
FX.summary: The Pound Sterling (GBP) retreats some 0.09% against the US Dollar (USD) on Friday as the latest US inflation report reaffirmed Federal Reserve (Fed) Chair Kevin Warsh's view that the labor market is “consistent with full employment.” GBP/USD trades near the o
FX.reason: Direct GBP/USD move driven by US data reopening Fed-hike debate; USD strength is the dominant FX impulse weighing on sterling.

FX.title: European Central Bank: September hike path and oil risks – Nomura
FX.summary: Nomura’s Global Markets Research team, led by Andrzej Szczepaniak, George Buckley and Josie Anderson, expects the ECB to raise the depo rate by 25bp to 2.50% at the 10 September meeting and then pause.
FX.reason: A near-term ECB hike is EUR-supportive vs USD; clear policy-driven positive for EUR in USD-centric framework.

FX.title: Eurozone: Inflation above target into 2027 – Nordea
FX.summary: Nordea expects Eurozone inflation dynamics to stay persistent, with headline inflation projected above the ECB’s target at least until spring 2027.
FX.reason: Persistent inflation implies higher-for-longer ECB policy, which supports EUR versus USD — a significant macro driver for FX.

FX.title: European Central Bank: Dovish hold may follow September hike - Rabobank
FX.summary: Rabobank's Senior Macro Strategist Bas van Geffen expects the European Central Bank (ECB) to hike its deposit rate by 25bp to 2.50% next week and then hold at that level for an extended period.
FX.reason: Highlights risk that EUR gains from a September hike may be limited by a dovish hold; counter-signal to EUR-hawkish views with modest relevance.

FX.title: United States Dollar Index rises as strong NFP revives Fed hike bets
FX.summary: The United States Dollar Index (DXY) rises some 0.17% on Friday following a stellar Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) report, with the economy creating nearly three times as many jobs as expected by most economists, as reported by the Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS).
FX.reason: Broad DXY appreciation post-NFP is the dominant USD-centric narrative — increases Fed-hike odds and pressures non-USD currencies across the board.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar slides as Canada sheds 41.7K jobs, US payrolls surge
FX.summary: USD/CAD accelerates sharply higher on Friday, trading around 1.3850 at the time of writing, up 0.39% on the day.
FX.reason: Large Canadian job loss against a strong US payroll print drives USD/CAD higher; direct bilateral USD strength vs CAD.

FX.title: Australian Dollar resumes advance as US Dollar loses post-NFP momentum
FX.summary: AUD/USD resumes its advance on Friday after a brief bout of weakness following a stronger-than-expected United States (US) employment report.
FX.reason: Intraday USD retracement supported AUD; represents a non-USD currency regaining ground amid volatile post-NFP flows.

FX.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Euro forms potential higher low above 100-day SMA
FX.summary: EUR/USD sees sharp two-way price swings on Friday after a stronger-than-expected United States (US) employment report triggers fresh volatility. The pair initially fell to an intraday low of 1.1585 before recovering as the US Dollar (USD) struggled to sustain
FX.reason: Technical price-forecast signal for EUR/USD (higher-low above 100-day SMA); limited relevance per framework but indicates potential EUR resilience amid volatility.

FX.title: Swiss Franc loses ground upbeat US Nonfarm Payrolls
FX.summary: USD/CHF trades higher on Friday as stronger-than-expected United States (US) Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) data trigger fresh volatility. The pair jumped to 0.8126 following the release before giving back part of its advance. At the time of writing, USD/CHF trades ar
FX.reason: Direct CHF weakness versus USD after strong NFP; clear bilateral reaction consistent with broad USD strength narrative.

FX.title: Indonesian Rupiah: Two-way risks around support levels – OCBC
FX.summary: OCBC’s Christopher Wong notes that USD/IDR has pulled back as a softer Dollar and lower UST yields support the Indonesian Rupiah. He highlights Bank Indonesia Governor Destry Damayanti’s emphasis on a stability-first approach, prioritizing Rupiah and macro sta
FX.reason: Softer USD and lower UST yields have supported IDR — a localized EM FX reaction tied directly to USD/UST moves and central bank posture.

FX.title: Indian Rupee: Dollar inflows support INR but impulse may fade – OCBC
FX.summary: OCBC’s Christopher Wong notes that strong foreign-currency inflows linked to the RBI’s special measures have bolstered the Indian Rupee (INR) and strengthened the central bank’s FX buffer.
FX.reason: Policy-led FX inflows have temporarily supported INR; relevant for INR but may be transitory so relevance is moderate.

FX.title: USD/MXN Price Forecast: Peso rally targets April 2024 low
FX.summary: The Mexican Peso appreciates against the US Dollar, testing two-year highs near 16.85 as the USD/MXN sets aside a strong US Nonfarm Payrolls report, which was ignored by the Peso’s bears.
FX.reason: Peso strength despite strong US NFP points to idiosyncratic MXN flows and risk-appetite drivers; technical/flow forecast with moderate relevance.

FX.title: HK’s Lee Says City to Expand Offshore Yuan Usage in 5-Year Plan
FX.reason: Policy push to expand offshore yuan usage is structurally supportive for offshore CNY demand and internationalisation — positive for CNY vs USD over the medium term.

Commodities.title: Gold falls as traders increase Fed hawkish bets after stellar NFP
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) price retreats by about 0.80% on Friday, after registering losses of over 2% following the release of an upbeat US jobs report.
Commodities.reason: Stronger-than-expected US NFP lifts Fed-hawk expectations and the dollar, which is a direct headwind for gold (lower real/nominal demand). This is a clear macro-driven move in precious metals, so assign high relevance and a materially negative direction.

Commodities.title: Silver claws back post-NFP losses after briefly crashing below $65
Commodities.summary: Silver (XAG/USD) trades around $66.20 at the time of writing on Friday, down 1.18% on the day, after recovering part of its sharp post-Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) decline.
Commodities.reason: Silver followed gold's post‑NFP weakness as rate/dollar dynamics weigh on precious metals. Recovery is partial; the dominant impulse remains NFP-driven downward pressure, so score as moderately negative with standard relevance.

Commodities.title: Russian gold floods through Hong Kong in wake of western sanctions
Commodities.summary: Shipments hit record high with almost 100 tonnes imported from Russia in first seven months of this year
Commodities.reason: Large incremental supply into Hong Kong (almost 100t) represents a meaningful increase in available physical gold flows, which can exert downward pressure on prices—notable supply-side development for the gold market.

Commodities.title: OPEC+ set to hold oil output policy steady for October - Reuters
Commodities.reason: OPEC+ keeping output steady is broadly price‑neutral to slightly negative if markets were pricing additional support; absent cuts this removes an upside catalyst. Relevance is material but not extreme on its own.

Commodities.title: A $1.6 Billion Quant ETF Pivots to Huge Oil Bet as Adviser Exits
Commodities.reason: Material portfolio repositioning into oil from a $1.6bn ETF signals increased investor flow into crude — a positive for oil prices via positioning and demand for futures exposure. Modest-to-moderate relevance for physical/price impact.

Commodities.title: Elevated crack spreads and crude oil prices contribute to higher prices at the pump
Commodities.summary: What are crack spreads and why are they elevated? Crack spreads are indicators of the profitability of refining crude oil into petroleum products such as gasoline and diesel. One common crack spread is calculated by subtracting the spot market price of a gallo
Commodities.reason: Elevated crack spreads indicate tight product/refining markets and higher product prices, which tends to support crude valuations and refinery economics — constructive for oil and petroleum products.

Commodities.title: Iraq Is in Process of Seeking Oil Tankers for Hormuz Strait Runs
Commodities.reason: Iraq seeking dedicated tankers to run Hormuz indicates heightened concern about transit security and potential route disruption — a supply‑risk signal that supports higher oil risk premia and prices.

Commodities.title: U.S. attacks 3 Iranian oil tankers after missiles target Navy warships
Commodities.summary: Three Iranian crude oil carriers were hit by U.S. forces on Saturday near Iran's key oil export hub, Kharg Island, in the Gulf, U.S. Central Command reported.
Commodities.reason: Direct military strikes on oil tankers near a major export hub materially raise short‑term supply disruption risk and risk premia for crude — a high‑relevance geopolitical shock that is strongly price‑positive for oil.

Commodities.title: Brent: Questionable flows, fragile outlook – Commerzbank
Commodities.summary: Commerzbank’s Commodity Research team, led by Barbara Lambrecht, notes that uncertainty over crude flows through the Strait of Hormuz and conflicting transit data are clouding the outlook for Brent.
Commodities.reason: Analyst note highlighting uncertain flows through Hormuz reinforces a supply‑risk narrative for Brent — constructive for prices given the chokepoint's importance, with moderate-to-high relevance.

Commodities.title: U.S. LNG exports rose 23% in the first half of 2026 because of higher capacity
Commodities.summary: U.S. liquefied natural gas (LNG) exports averaged 17.4 billion cubic feet per day (Bcf/d) in the first six months of the year, 23% more than the same period in 2025, according to our Natural Gas Monthly. In our latest Short-Term Energy Outlook, we estimate U.S
Commodities.reason: Substantially higher LNG exports (driven by added capacity) increase external demand for US natural gas and tighten domestic/Atlantic balances, a supportive fundamental for natural gas prices and global gas markets.

Crypto.title: IMF confirms El Salvador’s bitcoin growth was funded by private donations, not public money
Crypto.reason: Adoption narrative: confirmation that bitcoin buy/growth in a sovereign (El Salvador) was privately funded reduces fiscal/political backlash risk while preserving the adoption precedent. Positive for long-run crypto legitimacy but limited market-moving scope, so moderate relevance.

Crypto.title: South Korea targets February 2027 rollout for full tokenized securities market
Crypto.reason: Infrastructure / institutionalization: government-backed tokenized securities market is a major on-ramp for institutional capital and regulated digital-asset product growth. This materially strengthens the adoption/regulatory narrative and has high relevance to sector flows and product development.

Crypto.title: From warning to listing: UK’s largest retail investment platform opens access to crypto ETNs
Crypto.reason: Retail access / productization: major wealth platform listing crypto ETNs marks a shift from caution to distribution, expanding retail and adviser access to regulated crypto exposure. Material adoption signal with strong relevance for flows into BTC/ETH ETFs/ETNs.

Crypto.title: Bitget in talks with Wall Street giants including BlackRock to fuel Asian distribution
Crypto.reason: Institutional distribution: talks between a major crypto exchange and large asset managers to expand Asian distribution point to growing institutional-commercial linkages and product distribution capacity—positive for liquidity and market maturity.

Crypto.title: SoFi, Kraken tie up as crypto and banking push into each other's turf
Crypto.reason: Mainstream integration: partnership between a consumer bank/fintech and a major crypto exchange signals product convergence and easier rails for on/off ramping—supportive for adoption and retail flow into crypto products.

Crypto.title: U.S. banking agency gives blockchain bank OpenReserve initial OK to operate
Crypto.reason: Regulatory / institutional infrastructure: official bank-level approval for a blockchain-native bank lowers operational and custody uncertainty and increases the credibility of crypto financial plumbing—positive and directly relevant to institutional adoption.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin back above $81,000 as hike odds fade, Zcash leads with 15% jump
Crypto.reason: Macro/price transmission: BTC rally tied to fading rate-hike odds is a clear USD/rates-to-crypto transmission. Positive momentum amplified by monetary expectations makes this a higher-relevance market signal for crypto positioning.

Crypto.title: Southeast Asia’s crypto funding rebounds to $680 million as investors focus on mature firms
Crypto.reason: Venture / capital flows: rebound in regional crypto funding focused on mature firms supports ecosystem growth and signals investor willingness to deploy capital—positive for longer-term project development and regional market depth.

Crypto.title: A memecoin making app becomes crypto’s top fee generators as Robinhood Chain activity explodes
Crypto.reason: On-chain activity: surge in memecoin-related fees and platform activity indicates strong user engagement and fee-generating volume. Positive for network monetization and short-term liquidity, though it may reflect speculative flows rather than broad fundamental demand.

Crypto.title: Why crypto experts say buying and holding bitcoin easily beats trying to time the market
Crypto.reason: Investor behavior narrative: reinforcement of buy-and-hold strategy supports stable long-term inflows and reduced short-term churn. Positive for structural demand though lower immediate market impact.

Crypto.title: U.S. Sheriff’s association shifts opposition stance to Clarity Act to 'neutral'
Crypto.reason: Policy signal: an influential association moving from opposition to neutral on crypto-related legislation reduces political resistance and the risk of punitive measures. Positive regulatory impulse with straightforward relevance to legal/regulatory uncertainty.
